events.title: Discarded Doctrine - Journey Guide Fleet Mastery
events.description:
https://swgohevents.com/event/executor

Unlocks at 4 stars

Event requires you to complete 4 tiers with 4, 5, 6, 7 star ships. Once you complete the 4 tiers you unlock the Executor at 4 stars. This also unlocks a bonus tier that rewards 10 ship blueprints that is replayable every time the event returns. The bonus event can be refreshed 19 times for 999 crystals each time. Packs will be available after meeting the character requirements at 1250 crystals for 10 blueprints (with no limit on purchases).

The event is expected to run 1 time per month but may change its frequency in the future

Cost to Star

Below is the cost to star Executor during one event. If you are grinding Executor over several events then this won't be relevant. This assumes you will refresh the event as many times as needed before buying packs.

4 star - 0 crystals
5 star - 5,994 crystals
6 star - 13,986 crystals
7 star - 25,231 crystals

Requirements to View and Begin the Event
These requirements are necessary before you can even attempt to do the event.
Darth Vader Relic 7

Boba Fett Relic 8
TIE Fighter Pilot Relic 5
